about.body: I learned to [code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_development) just to build websites, and now [understanding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_experience) how [people and machines](https://transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace/) behave is the part of [engineering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_engineering) I'm best at.

featured.body: So, what do you want to see?

footer.body: Open to [product](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Product_management) and [machine learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning) roles, and being convinced otherwise. Always up for [side quests](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Start_up).
